releaseApproval.reviewer: User-authorized v2.0.4 playback startup and diagnostic patch; persistent format contracts reviewed unchanged
evidence: Prepares and authenticates the first encrypted video chunk in the owner page before relay registration. The probe reuses the bounded chunk cache. Persistent encryption, SQLite, backup and client mutation formats remain unchanged from v1.3.7.

Full local make test passed: 560 frontend tests, TypeScript typecheck, lint/production build, Go vet/tests, installer/update tests, format and release-package contract checks, and three TLS proxy tests. New tests cover cold chunk ordering/cache reuse, startup timeout/cancellation, lifecycle cleanup and whitelist-only diagnostics. Existing lint warnings remain.

Local Chrome 155 passed real encrypted upload, Range-based playback and seek of a 323 MiB six-second H.264 MP4 padded with a free box; a short H.264 MP4 also used Range playback successfully. This does not certify a content-heavy long video or a physical iPhone.

The user reports iPhone long-video success and short-video failure, and desktop short-video success and long-video probe timeout. The production fault has not been reproduced locally and the exact original files are unavailable. The release exposes first-block bytes, network retry state and GET/HEAD probe substeps without keys, filenames or session URLs.
Publication requires full local make test, exact-commit main CI with all-package race tests and Linux amd64/arm64 builds, followed by released archive checksum verification.

scope: XDrive v2.0.4 separates encrypted video first-block preparation from Range relay probing and adds startup byte progress and safe diagnostics; persistent data formats unchanged

sqlite.migrationPolicy: forward only; after a schema-changing migration, restore the matching pre-migration database and binary before rollback

clientMutationProtocol.acceptance: exact match only; reject missing, older, and future versions before reading mutation bodies

evolutionPolicy: Unknown payload versions and unknown fields remain fail-closed.
The listed optional fields and their absent-value meanings are part of the current schema contract.
Adding or redefining a payload field requires a new payload schema version; it must not silently expand an older strict reader.
A change that makes a stale client unsafe for mutations increments the client mutation protocol version in Go and TypeScript.
Key derivation or AAD meaning changes use their own crypto version; they do not reuse a payload schema number.
SQLite schema migration, backup container format, encrypted object envelope, and browser payload schema are independent version dimensions.
